description: This file contains helper functions for date formatting used across the application, specifically formatting DateTime objects into 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'HH:mm:ss' string representations.

classes.name: DateHelpers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for date formatting functions used throughout the app.

methods.name: formatYmd
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string of the form 'YYYY-MM-DD' in UTC.

methods.name: formatHms
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string of the form 'HH:mm:ss'.
